description: One fixed synthetic consumer and bounded CPU cost study; descriptive results on one shared machine
decision: Retain the existing native kernel. Checked-call observations do not locate a justified internal C++ optimization. No speed or model-ranking guarantee follows.
compiler_disposition: Native opaque fullgraph Inductor forward/backward passed this case. Known-valid built-in composition failed generated C++ compilation when paths containing spaces were split. Toolchain was present; no eager fallback or retry is called success.
privacy_transform: Only absolute local paths were replaced by placeholders. Numerical data, raw timing blocks, losses, statuses, errors and hashes were retained. <study root with spaces> preserves the relevant path property in the failed compiler command. Original private receipt hashes identify the unmodified retained files, not the sanitized public objects.

protocol.task: Balanced latent presence, one signal in each positive bag
protocol.signal: normal mean [3,0,0,0], unit covariance, clipped to [-6,6]
protocol.construction: one positive and negative per sampled length, independent contents, shuffled bags
protocol.shared_initialization: encoder then head then optional scorer, same seed
protocol.batch_order: CPU torch.Generator seed 81000+model_seed, randperm each epoch
protocol.checkpoint: minimum validation BCE, earliest update breaks ties
protocol.permutation: reverse each held-out bag, preserve bag order
limitations: Three initialization seeds support descriptive comparisons only
Longer bags also dilute a single signal among more nuisance items
Attention coefficients are not causal explanations
